verdict.rationale: Signifyd does run some user-configured logic in the background without manual action. If Decision Center is enabled, policies set at the Sale checkpoint are applied automatically to incoming orders, and webhooks push guarantee decisions to the store in real time. However, these are narrow, fraud-specific mechanisms rather than a general automation builder. Missing for 10: a general-purpose way to define custom automations or workflows, scheduled or background agent tasks, documentation of how policies are configured, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
